XXXX XXXX XXXX Subject : **Cease and Desist of Communication Under 15 U.S.C . 1692c ( c ) ** Dear XXXX XXXX XXXX I am writing to formally request that you immediately cease and desist any further communication with me in regard to the debt referenced in your records.

Pursuant to 15 U.S.C. 1692c ( c ) of the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act ( FDCPA ), I am exercising my right to request that you stop contacting me about this alleged debt. Specifically, I am requesting that you refrain from any further written, verbal, or any other form of communication, including phone calls, letters, and emails, unless it is for the purpose of notifying me that your collection efforts have ceased, or you are taking specific legal action.
